FeinwerkCampaignScore.FindingsDocumentation: Shows where your campaign values are not clean. A clean value is lowercase and uses only a to z, 0 to 9, underscore, hyphen and full stop. Spelling variants are values that only differ in case, spaces, underscores, hyphens or full stops; the suggestion is the most visited clean variant. A medium is unusual when it is not in the list in the settings. Keywords are only checked for spelling variants, because they often hold search terms.

FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginAuthSamlText: Auth SAML connects Matomo to your identity provider: SAML 2.0 single sign-on, SCIM 2.0 on- and offboarding and site permissions driven by your IdP groups. For Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak and any SAML provider.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginChannelGroupingText: Group hundreds of traffic sources into the marketing channels you actually steer: Organic, Paid, Email, Social or your own.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginConversionsApiText: Conversions API sends your Matomo goals and ecommerce orders server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, Microsoft Advertising, ChatGPT Ads and TikTok: with consent per platform, automatic click attribution and close to real time.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginEmailReportsProText: Email Reports Pro turns your Matomo data into designed email reports: key figures with their trend, clear charts and tables that make even multi-level reports readable. You put every report together from building blocks and see in the preview how the email arrives.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginSearchReportText: Search Report imports Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools into native Matomo reports: daily, automatically, with unlimited history beyond Google's 16-month limit.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginSentinelProText: Sentinel Pro adds visit forecasts, public holidays and alarms per channel and conversion rate to the free Sentinel, plus a watchdog that speaks up when Sentinel itself stops.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginTrackingRouterText: Keep every website in its own profile and add a shared profile with continuous sessions: one tracking request, copied on the server to the sites you allow.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginTrackingSpamScoreText: Spots bot traffic by how whole groups of visits behave, shows it per network and blocks it while tracking, server-side.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PaidPluginVisitJourneyText: A funnel with no presets: Visit Journey shows, for every goal and every order, which steps really came before it: pages, events, other goals and the channel the visit came through, as an interactive flow chart in Matomo.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PremiumAskSuperUser: Your Matomo super user can install it.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PromoCampaignsLineText: These errors start when links are built. Feinwerk Campaigns prevents them with one naming convention for the whole team.

FeinwerkCampaignScore.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PromoCardText: Your team builds every link by your naming convention.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreBasis: %1$s of %2$s campaign visits with clean values
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreDocumentation: The share of campaign visits whose campaign name (and source and medium, when Marketing Campaigns Reporting is active) is clean. Visits that Matomo grouped as "Others" cannot be checked and are not part of the basis.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreFieldsAll: Checked fields: campaign name, source and medium.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreMetricDocumentation: Share of campaign visits with clean values in percent.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreNoData: No campaign visits in this period.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.ScoreUnchecked: %s campaign visits could not be checked (rows grouped as "Others", masked values, or visits from before Marketing Campaigns Reporting was activated).
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingAcceptedDescription: One value per line, written exactly as in the report. These values count as clean and are no longer shown as findings. Admins can also accept a value directly in the findings table.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingMediumsDescription: One medium per line. Campaign Score shows a campaign medium outside this list as unusual. The default list holds the mediums that Feinwerk Channel Grouping assigns to a channel. Leave the field empty to use the default list.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingNamePatternDescription: Optional. A regular expression every campaign name should match, for example ^[0-9]{4}- for names that start with a year. Empty: no pattern.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSeparatorDescription: The character that separates words in campaign values. A value with the other character is a finding. With "Either", only values that mix both are.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSiteMediumsDescription: One medium per line for this website. Empty: the list of the general settings applies.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSiteNamePatternDescription: Optional. A regular expression for the campaign names of this website. Empty: the pattern of the general settings applies.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingSourceAliasesDescription: Treat common other spellings of large platforms as the same source, for example fb and m.facebook.com as facebook.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SettingTypoHintsDescription: List values that differ by one or two letters, such as newsleter and newsletter. These hints do not lower the score.
FeinwerkCampaignScore.SitesLimited: Showing the %s websites with the most visits.
